Definition: an Arkevite (collectively) or native of Erek
BiblicalUsage: The Archevites are named once, among the peoples who wrote to Artaxerxes against the rebuilding of the temple. They are listed with the Babylonians, the Elamites and the rest, a people settled in Samaria who wanted the work stopped.
TheologicalSignificance: A people named once for opposing the temple reminds me that God's work has always had organised opposition, and that the letter-writers are remembered for standing against it.
